    • isPathAllowed

      public boolean isPathAllowed(Path path) throws IOException
      Normalizes path then checks if path starts with user folder path
      Parameters:
      path - Path to validate
      Returns:
      true if path is valid (starts with user folder path "./root/userfolderBase32/...") else returns false
      Throws:
      IOException - When user folder doesn't exist or not found it will create it however will throw IOException if it can't

    • generateIdPaths

      @Deprecated public String generateIdPaths(String filePath, String startingIdPath) throws IOException
      Deprecated.
      Generates ID path string

      Splits path into a String array, then prepends given starting ID Path. For each folder fetches folders with similar ID Paths for a user , then checks for same name and depth. If it satisfies both depth increases and the folder's ID is added to StringBuilder.

      Parameters:
      filePath - Starting folder path
      startingIdPath - Starting folder's ID Path
      Returns:
      Generated ID Path
      Throws:
      IOException - I/O Error if user folder cannot be found or created
